ayahOccurrences.text: أَفَتَطْمَعُونَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ لَكُمْ وَقَدْ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ كَلَٰمَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُحَرِّفُونَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا عَقَلُوهُ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَقَفَّيْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ بِٱلرُّسُلِ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَا عِيسَى ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَأَيَّدْنَٰهُ بِرُوحِ ٱلْقُدُسِ ۗ أَفَكُلَّمَا جَآءَكُمْ رَسُولٌۢ بِمَا لَا تَهْوَىٰٓ أَنفُسُكُمُ ٱسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ فَفَرِيقًا كَذَّبْتُمْ وَفَرِيقًا تَقْتُلُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَا تَتْلُوا۟ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ عَلَىٰ مُلْكِ سُلَيْمَٰنَ ۖ وَمَا كَفَرَ سُلَيْمَٰنُ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُعَلِّمُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ ٱلسِّحْرَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَى ٱلْمَلَكَيْنِ بِبَابِلَ هَٰرُوتَ وَمَٰرُوتَ ۚ وَمَا يُعَلِّمَانِ مِنْ أَحَدٍ حَتَّىٰ يَقُولَآ إِنَّمَا نَحْنُ فِتْنَةٌ فَلَا تَكْفُرْ ۖ فَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مِنْهُمَا مَا يُفَرِّقُونَ بِهِۦ بَيْنَ ٱلْمَرْءِ وَزَوْجِهِۦ ۚ وَمَا هُم بِضَآرِّينَ بِهِۦ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ مَا يَضُرُّهُمْ وَلَا يَنفَعُهُمْ ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمُوا۟ لَمَنِ ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مَا لَهُۥ فِى الْآخِرَةِ مِنْ خَلَٰقٍ ۚ وَلَبِئْسَ مَا شَرَوْا۟ بِهِۦٓ أَنفُسَهُمْ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: قُولُوٓا۟ آمَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْنَا وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِۦمَ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَٱلْأَسْبَاطِ وَمَآ أُوتِىَ مُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَمَآ أُوتِىَ ٱلنَّبِيُّونَ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّنْهُمْ وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُسْلِمُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ فِيهِ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ هُدًى لِّلنَّاسِ وَبَيِّنَٰتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَٱلْفُرْقَانِ ۚ فَمَن شَهِدَ مِنكُمُ ٱلشَّهْرَ فَلْيَصُمْهُ ۖ وَمَن كَانَ مَرِيضًا أَوْ عَلَىٰ سَفَرٍ فَعِدَّةٌ مِّنْ أَيَّامٍ أُخَرَ ۗ يُرِيدُ ٱللَّهُ بِكُمُ ٱلْيُسْرَ وَلَا يُرِيدُ بِكُمُ ٱلْعُسْرَ وَلِتُكْمِلُوا۟ ٱلْعِدَّةَ وَلِتُكَبِّرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ مَا هَدَىٰكُمْ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: قُلْ آمَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا وَمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَٱلْأَسْبَاطِ وَمَآ أُوتِىَ مُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَٱلنَّبِيُّونَ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّنْهُمْ وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُسْلِمُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: وَٱعْتَصِمُوا۟ بِحَبْلِ ٱللَّهِ جَمِيعًا وَلَا تَفَرَّقُوا۟ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ كُنتُمْ أَعْدَآءً فَأَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِكُمْ فَأَصْبَحْتُم بِنِعْمَتِهِۦٓ إِخْوَٰنًا وَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰ شَفَا حُفْرَةٍ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ فَأَنقَذَكُم مِّنْهَا ۗ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ آيَاتِهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ

lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
فَرَقَ faraqa i [v. trans.]

1 to split, to part

(2:50)‏ ‏وَإِذ ‏فَرَقْنَا‏ بِكُمُ‏ ‏الْبَحْرَ and when We parted the sea for you‏ [also interpreted as: by your going through it, i.e. used you to part the sea]

2 to spread over a period of time, to give something in instalments or in several parts; to make distinct

(17:106) وَقُرْءَانًا‏ ‏فَرَقْنَاهُ‏ ‏لِتَقْرَأَهُ‏ ‏عَلَى النَّاسِ‏ ‏عَلَى‏ ‏مُكْثٍ‏‏ ‏it is a Qur’an/Recitation that We have revealed in parts, so that you recite it to people at intervals

3 to judge between, to arbitrate

(5:25) رَبِّ إِنِّي لاَ أَمْلِكُ إِلاَّ نَفْسِي وَأَخِي فَافْرُقْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ الْقَوْمِ الْفَاسِقِينَ‏ my Lord, I have control only over myself and my brother, so judge between the two of us [also interpreted as: separate between us and these disobedient people].

entries.definitionHtml:
تَفَرَّق tafarraq [v. V, intrans.]

1 to part, to separate from one another

(4:130) وَإِنْ يَتَفَرَّقَا يُغْنِ اللَّهُ كُلاًّ مِنْ سَعَتِهِ but if they [husband and wife] do separate, God will provide for each out of His plenty ‏

2 to become disunited, to split into factions

(3:105)‏وَلاَ تَكُونُوا كَالَّذِينَ تَفَرَّقُوا وَاخْتَلَفُوا مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا جَاءَهُمُ الْبَيِّنَاتُ‏ do not be like those who, after they have been given clear revelation, split into factions and fall into disputes

3 [with prep. ﺒ] to divert, to lead away

(6:153)‏وَأَنَّ‏ ‏هَذَا صِرَاطِي‏ ‏مُسْتَقِيمًا فَاتَّبِعُوهُ‏ ‏وَلاَ‏ ‏تَتَّبِعُوا‏ ‏السُّبُلَ‏ ‏فَتَفَرَّقَ‏ ‏بِكُمْ‏ ‏عَنْ‏‏ سَبِيلِهِ‏ this is My path, leading straight, so follow it, and do not follow [other] ways–they will lead you away from His way.

entries.label: تَفْريق
entries.definitionHtml:
تَفْريق tafrıq [v. n.] sowing dissension

(9:107) وَالَّذِينَ‏ ‏اتَّخَذُوا‏ مَسْجِدًا‏ ‏ضِرَارًا وَكُفْرًا‏ ‏وَتَفْرِيقًا‏ ‏بَيْنَ‏ ‏الْمُؤْمِنِينَ and those who built a mosque [in an attempt] to cause harm, disbelief and dissension among the believers.

entries.label: فارِق
entries.definitionHtml:
فارِق fāriq [imper. v. III, trans.] part from, separate from

(65:2) فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ when they have completed their appointed term, either keep them honourably, or separate from them honourably. ‏

entries.label: فارِقات
entries.definitionHtml:
فارِقات fāriqāt [pl. of fem. act. part. فَارِقَة fāriqatun] ones who discriminate; ones who separate, ones who sort out

(77:1–4) وَالْمُرْسَلاَتِ‏ ‏عُرْفًا‏ ‏فَالْعَاصِفَاتِ‏ ‏عَصْفًا ‏وَالنَّاشِرَاتِ‏ ‏نَشْرًا‏ ‏فَالْفَارِقَاتِ‏ ‏فَرْقًا‏ by the emissaries sent forth in swift succession, then violently storming, then scattering far and wide, then distinguishing separately.

entries.label: فَريق
entries.definitionHtml:
فَريق farıq [n.; dual فَرِيقَان farıqān]

1 group, faction

(42:7)‏فَرِيقٌ‏ ‏فِى الْجَنَّةِ‏ ‏وَفَرِيقٌ‏ ‏فِى‏ ‏السَّعِيرِ one group is in the Garden and one group is in Hellfire; *

(11:24) الفَرِيقَيْن the two groups (an epithet for the believers and the non-believers)

2 some, section

(2:188)‏لِتَأْكُلُوا‏ ‏فَرِيقًا‏ ‏مِنْ‏ ‏أَمْوَالِ‏ ‏النَّاسِ بِالإِثْمِ‏‏ that you may usurp some of other people’s property sinfully.

entries.label: فَرَّقَ
entries.definitionHtml:
فَرَّقَ farraqa [v. II, trans.]

1 to fragment, to split into fragments, to divide, to splinter

(6:159)‏ الَّذِينَ فَرَّقُوا‏ ‏دِينَهُمْ وَكَانُوا‏ ‏شِيَعًا‏‏ ‏those who have splintered their religion and become factions

2 to make a distinction between

(2:285)‏‏لاَ‏ ‏نُفَرِّقُ‏ ‏بَيْنَ‏ ‏أَحَدٍ‏ ‏مِنْ‏ ‏رُسُلِهِ ‏ we make no distinction between any of His messengers

3 to sow dissension, to cause discord

(2:102) فَيَتَعَلَّمُونَ‏ ‏مِنْهُمَا‏ ‏مَا‏ ‏يُفَرِّقُونَ‏ ‏بِهِ‏ ‏بَيْنَ‏ ‏الْمَرْءِ وَزَوْجِهِ‏ ‏so, from these two, they learn that by which they can cause discord between a man and his wife.

entries.label: فَرْق
entries.definitionHtml:
فَرْق farq [v. n.] distinguishing, separating, discriminating

(77:1–4) وَالْمُرْسَلاَتِ‏ ‏عُرْفًا‏ ‏فَالْعَاصِفَاتِ‏ ‏عَصْفًا ‏وَالنَّاشِرَاتِ‏ ‏نَشْرًا‏ ‏فَالْفَارِقَاتِ‏ ‏فَرْقًا‏ by the emissaries sent forth in swift succession, then violently storming, then scattering far and wide, then distinguishing separately.

entries.label: فُرْقان
entries.definitionHtml:
فُرْقان furqān [v. n./n.]

1 the criterion for distinguishing right and wrong, a standard by which to discern the true from the false

(8:29) إِنْ تَتَّقُوا اللَّهَ يَجْعَلْ لَكُمْ فُرْقَانًا if you remain conscious of God, He will give you a criterion of discrimination [between right and wrong]; *

(8:41) يَوْمَ الْفُرْقَانِ the day of decision or, the day when the truth was distinguished from the false [interpreted as either: the day when the Muslims and Quraysh fought their first battle at Badr (in the year

2 A.H./

623 A.D.), or

(3:155, 166) the day when the armies of Quraysh and its allies fought the Muslims in the battle of ʾuḥud (in

3 A.H./

624 A.D.)]

2 (possibly) body of religious teachings, guidance *

(2:53) وَإِذْ‏ ‏ءَاتَيْنَا‏ ‏مُوسَى الْكِتَابَ وَالْفُرْقَانَ‏ ‏لَعَلَّكُمْ‏ ‏تَهْتَدُونَ remember when We gave Moses the Scripture, and the guidance that you may find the right way

3 the Qur’an, the Differentiator

(25:1) تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي نَزَّلَ الْفُرْقَانَ عَلَى عَبْدِهِ لِيَكُونَ لِلْعَالَمِينَ نَذِيرًا‏ ‏exalted is He who has sent down the Differentiator to His servant that it/he may be to all beings a warner; * الْفُرْقَانَ‏ name of Sura 25, Meccan sura, so-named because of the reference in verse

1 to the ‘Scripture that Distinguishes Right from Wrong’.

entries.label: فِراق
entries.definitionHtml:
فِراق firāq [v. n.] separation, severance

(18:78)‏قَالَ‏ ‏هَذَا‏ ‏فِرَاقُ‏ ‏بَيْنِي‏ ‏وَبَيْنِكَ‏ he said, ‘This is the parting between you and me.’

entries.label: فِرْق
entries.definitionHtml:
فِرْق firq [n.] section, division, side

(26:63)‏فَانْفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَالطَّوْدِ الْعَظِيمِ so it parted–each side like a mighty mountain.

entries.label: فِرْقةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
فِرْقةٌ firqatun [n.] party, group, company

(9:122)‏فَلَوْلاَ‏ ‏نَفَرَ‏ ‏مِنْ‏ ‏كُلِّ‏ ‏فِرْقَةٍ‏ مِنْهُمْ‏ ‏طَائِفَةٌ‏ so if only a [single] party out of each group of them were to go forth.

entries.label: مُتَفَرِّق
entries.definitionHtml:
مُتَفَرِّق mutafarriq [act. part.; fem. متَفَرِّقَة mutafarriqatun; pl. مُتَفَرِّقون mutafarriqūn]

1 different

(12:67) مُتَفَرِّقَةٍ ‏ ‏وَادْخُلُوا‏ ‏مِنْ‏ ‏أَبْوَابٍ but enter through different gates ‏

2 several; divided

(12:39) ءَأَرْبَابٌ مُتَفَرِّقُونَ خَيْرٌ أَمِ اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ‏ would several gods at variance be better or God, the One, the All‐Powerful?

entries.label: يَفْرَقُون
entries.definitionHtml:
يَفْرَقُون yafraqūn [imperf. of v. فَرِقَ fariqa, intrans.] to fear, to take fright, to run away

(9:56) ‏وَلَكِنَّهُمْ‏ ‏قَوْمٌ‏ ‏يَفْرَقُونَ ‏but they are, in fact, people who take fright.

entries.label: يُفْرَق
entries.definitionHtml:
يُفْرَق yufraq [pass. imperf.] to be made distinct; to be decreed, to be decided

(44:4) ‏فِيهَا‏ ‏يُفْرَقُ‏ ‏كُلُّ‏ ‏أَمْرٍ‏ حَكِيمٍ [a night] in which every matter of wisdom is made distinct.
